Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse, recording 28 matching passages shared with 11 other Pali works, while yielding no cross-language alignments with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive alignment is with the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo), which covers segments §1.2–5.4 across six matches [DharmaNexus].
